name: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co.,Ltd.
summary: Xinjiang Daqo New Energy Co.,Ltd. focuses on the development, manufacturing, and commercialization of polysilicon, a vital component for the solar photovoltaic industry. Their offerings include various P-type single crystal polysilicon materials, specifically coral, dense aniseed, and compound feeding types. They also provide polycrystalline products such as loose bars, dense blocks, and bulk materials. Founded in 2011, the company's main operations are located in Shihezi, China, and it functions as an affiliate of Daqo New Energy Corp.
